# Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection in this paper changes the sign of only one pion field, differing from refs.[3, 12, 7] where all three pion fields' signs are altered
- This definition provides a more natural comparison with monopole scenarios
# Skyrmion and AntiSkyrmion Characteristics
- The profile function becomes zero at a radius s/2 from the Skyrmion/antiSkyrmion center
- The fields are set to vacuum outside each core, creating a continuous patch between Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion
# Initial Conditions
- Initial conditions were established using the simple ansatz (3.7)
- More advanced initial conditions were developed using the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map
